title: British expansion in the Northeast & Burma, 1824-1898
note: SAMPLE DATA. Borders are hand-traced approximations; troop figures are rough, commonly cited orders of magnitude, and several (marked as placeholders in the README) need checking. Verify everything against your sources before publishing.

keyframes.caption: War is declared on Konbaung Burma
Rangoon taken; Burmese win at Ramu
Bandula's army is beaten outside Rangoon
Bandula falls at Danubyu; Arakan and Assam taken
Gambhir Singh's Manipur Levy expels the Burmese
Treaty of Yandabo: Assam, Arakan, Tenasserim ceded
The Lushai Expedition marches on the hills
Third war: Mandalay falls, King Thibaw exiled
Upper Burma annexed to British India
Chin-Lushai Expedition; Fort Aijal is founded
The Lushai Hills district is formed under Assam

subtitles.text: *1824.* Britain goes to war with Burma
over Assam, Manipur and the frontier
By *1898* the hills are a district of Assam
